patch_description: Reverting to the higher-scoring RY→entangler→RZ sandwich architecture (score 0.60 baseline) and applying the suggested capacity reallocation: remove the two least-central CRY gates on edges (4,8) and (6,7), freeing two gate slots, and insert a lightweight mid-entangling RY sublayer on qubits [1,3,5,7,8] with unique parameters (ry_mid_0..ry_mid_4) between the entangling block and the final RZ layer. This keeps depth/gate-count comparable to the best-performing prior variant while testing whether extra single-qubit expressivity on strategically chosen qubits (those with fewer remaining entangling connections) improves generalization without inflating parameter count much (180 -> 183 params, well within budget).
